Kids vs grown-ups: who finds JINGLE first? 🎄

Here are 4 of the 50 puzzles in my Christmas Word Search book. One puzzle per page. The letters are large print, so they're easy to read and easy to solve, and your 7-year-old and your mom can play at the same table.

Print a stack for family game night or a long car ride. No printer? Solve them on a tablet in a PDF app.

It's US Letter 8.5 x 11 in and prints at 100% with no resizing. You'll get a print-ready PDF plus high-resolution JPG files as an instant digital download.
